newsitem.title: UK: UK TUC urges UK to enter EMU in first wave.
newsitem.headline: UK TUC urges UK to enter EMU in first wave.

text.p: The UK's Trade Unions Congress on Tuesday urged UK politicians from both parties to abandon their cautious "wait and see" approach to European monetary union and prepare the UK for entry in the first wave.

"The wait-and-see option which dominates mainstream political thinking in the main parties will become increasingly untenable," TUC general secretary John Monks told a conference hosted by a European think-tank.
"The option of committment to joining the first tranche of EMU membership is the one which, on balance, the TUC favours because the risks of the alternatives are too great," he said.
Monks said the UK was in danger of being excluded by default from what he said was the most important economic development in Europe since the war.
His comments may be seen as a snub to the Labour Party which, along with the ruling Conservatives, has said it will wait until nearer the 1999 deadline before making a decision on joining.
